input: root is None or the root of a finite, acyclic binary tree with no shared child nodes. TreeNode is a caller-supplied ordinary object with data fields val, left and right, without getters, proxies or concurrent mutation. Every child is a TreeNode or the None. Node values are plain integers in [-9007199254740991, 9007199254740991]. There are at most 4294967295 nodes. String inputs, when present, are ordinary str values, not subclasses. Integer values are plain int, excluding bool; lists are ordinary lists, not subclasses. There is no concurrent mutation or monkey-patching of standard built-ins. Preconditions are not checked at runtime. Allocation and runtime resource limits still require qualification; this declared domain is not a capacity or completion guarantee.
return: A fresh outer list of fresh level lists. Root depth zero is emitted left-to-right, depth one right-to-left, then alternating by depth. Child discovery always visits left before right; only copied level values are reversed. The absent root returns a fresh empty outer list.
mutation_aliasing: No node, value or child link is written. Input identities and caller-held aliases remain intact; local queues/stacks borrow node references only. The Solution instance retains no state. Every output level is a different mutable container and contains immutable integer values, not node references. No output container aliases the queue or an input node. Separate calls allocate independent results.
numeric: Node values are copied without arithmetic. Queue head, queue length, level endpoints and output lengths are exact integers bounded by node count. Reversal does not numerically transform values. The alternating flag is a boolean.
complexity: O(n + 1) time and O(n + 1) auxiliary space, plus O(n + 1) output storage. The append-only queue retains every discovered reference after head advances; it is not O(width) space. Reversing alternating levels touches at most n total values. No recursive traversal, front removal or repeated front insertion is used.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 859 UTF-8 bytes, including the Solution class, method signature, every loop, condition, allocation, standard built-in call, annotation/comment where present, whitespace and terminal newline. There are no custom helper definitions, imports, generated implementations or hidden source expansion. Built-in operations are not free: their allocations and work are included in the stated runtime/storage costs. TreeNode, where used, is an explicit caller-owned input shape and no node is constructed. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source; method-style interface parity with frozen sources remains unqualified.
